proposals.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Every malformed fixture is rejected or explicitly quarantined, recovery begins only at a record separator, record and byte budgets hold, and duplicate records receive no independent credit.
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded JSON text-sequence tribunal can preserve record boundaries, reject malformed or truncated scalars, resynchronize only at declared record separators, enforce budgets, and refuse duplicate evidence credit.
proposals.null_or_failure_condition: The tribunal accepts a missing record separator, invalid UTF-8, truncated scalar as complete, ambiguous recovery, unbounded record growth, or repeated records as independent evidence.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Disable streaming recovery, retain the failing bytes as a negative, and fall back to inert byte-preserving inspection.
